title: Sprint 3 — Processes, Services & Networking
description: Learn to manage system resources, handle background services, and configure essential networking.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Process Management
tickets.description:
Monitor running applications and analyze system resource usage.
Communicate with processes using standard system signals.
Manage job priorities and handle background execution.

tasks.title: Task 3.1.1 — Process Inspection
tasks.description: Analyze the current state of the system, identify resource-intensive applications, and understand the hierarchy of running programs.

tasks.title: Task 3.1.2 — Signals & kill
tasks.description: Practice sending various signals to applications to understand the difference between gracefully stopping and forcefully terminating them.

tasks.title: Task 3.1.3 — nice, nohup & jobs
tasks.description: Launch applications with adjusted priorities, run them in the background, and ensure they continue executing even after disconnecting.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — systemd & Service Management
tickets.description:
Control system services and manage application lifecycles.
Create custom configurations to run scripts as reliable services.
Understand and navigate different system boot states.

tasks.title: Task 3.2.1 — systemctl Basics
tasks.description: Manage background services by checking their health status, configuring them to start automatically on boot, and reviewing their logs.

tasks.title: Task 3.2.2 — Writing a Unit File
tasks.description: Create a custom service configuration that allows a script to run automatically, restart upon failure, and record its output.

tasks.title: Task 3.2.3 — Boot Targets & Runlevels
tasks.description: Learn to transition the system between different operational states and analyze the time taken during the boot process.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Linux Networking
tickets.description:
Configure network interfaces, assign addresses, and resolve domain names.
Monitor network traffic and identify active connections.
Secure the system by managing firewall rules and access policies.

tasks.title: Task 3.3.1 — Network Configuration
tasks.description: Review active network interfaces, assign static addresses, and configure domain name resolution settings.

tasks.title: Task 3.3.2 — Traffic Analysis
tasks.description: Identify open ports, monitor incoming and outgoing network traffic, and perform basic connectivity scans.

tasks.title: Task 3.3.3 — Firewall with iptables & firewalld
tasks.description: Implement firewall rules to control access to specific services, block unwanted traffic, and review active security policies.
